<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY ent 'Parsed Entity'>">
  %param;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY pic SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/ns/sub">
  <!-- Top level processing comment for deep parser paths -->
  <sub:child id="id1">
    <![CDATA[ CDATA block with entity reference &ent; and tags <child> ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&ent;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e_base "Base Item">
  <!ENTITY e_ref "&e_base; Extended">
  <!NOTATION text SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY external_doc SYSTEM "data.txt" NDATA text>
  <!ENTITY % dtd_macro "<!ATTLIST item cat CDATA #REQUIRED>">
  %dtd_macro;
]>
<?xml-target role="validation" value="strict"?>
<inventory xmlns="urn:inventory:schema" xmlns:meta="urn:inventory:meta">
  <!-- Comment containing markup-like strings <item>&e_ref;</item> -->
  <meta:details>
    <![CDATA[
      Raw payload with internal entities &e_ref; and CDATA nesting.
    ]]>
  </meta:details>
  <item cat="primary">&e_ref;</item>
</inventory>

  <!ENTITY ent1 "First Level">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; and Second Level">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc SYSTEM "file.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <!ENTITY % sub_macro "<!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>">
  %sub_macro;
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction test="true" data="sample"?>
<archive xmlns="http://schemas.org/archive" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/">
  <!-- Complex comment block with DTD imitation -->
  <record xlink:type="simple" dc:title="Test">
    <![CDATA[
      <record>Nested CDATA &ent2;</record>
    ]]>
  </record>
  <record>&ent2;</record>
</archive>

    ]]>
  </store:product>
  <product>&entB;</product>
</catalog>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY core "Core Entity">
  <!ENTITY extended "&core; with Expansion">
  <!NOTATION eps SYSTEM "image/eps">
  <!ENTITY graphic SYSTEM "figure.eps" NDATA eps>
  <!ENTITY % ent_decl "<!ENTITY internal 'Internal Macro Value'>">
  %ent_decl;
]>
<?xml-log level="debug" mode="verbose"?>
<document xmlns="http://xml.example.com/doc" xmlns:ns="http://xml.example.com/ns">
  <!-- Multi-line comment explaining the structure
       with entities &extended; and CDATA usage -->
  <ns:section id="sec1">
    <![CDATA[
      Data chunk containing &internal; and &extended;.
    ]]>
  </ns:section>
  <section>&extended; - &internal;</section>
</document>
